The "Terminus" is a proposition of qualified Theory. In essence, information is the tiniest building blocks of the (not the world... but of...). Information itself must be processed, experienced... That process is expensive yet embedded in the Human being. We are good at processing certain kinds of Information, and not others[^1]

The end purpose _...or Function..._ of Informaiton (and all sub-classes, Theorical, Analytical, etc.) is either to A: Translate into direct real-world action (), B: Translate into eventual action (such as in the case of Survival Theory) or C: Integrate into Conceptual models to approach action and decision-making (Such as in the case of Music Theory).

3 Classes of the Terminus, and Qualifiaction of Jutsfiied vs Unjustified infromation:
- Direct
- Latent
- Abstract

These are forms of Potentiality, in some sense.
